mapper.sql: id, goods_id, seller_id, buyer_id, goods_title, goods_cover, last_msg, last_time, seller_unread, buyer_unread, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user
mapper.select:
select
from chatsession where id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.update: update chatsession set last_msg = #{lastMsg}, last_time = #{lastTime}, seller_unread = seller_unread + case when #{senderId} = #{buyerId} then 1 else 0 end, buyer_unread = buyer_unread + case when #{senderId} = #{sellerId} then 1 else 0 end, update_time = #{lastTime}, update_user = #{updateUser} where id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: select cs.id as session_id, cs.goods_id, cs.seller_id, cs.buyer_id, cs.goods_title, cs.goods_cover, cs.last_msg, cs.last_time, case when cs.seller_id = #{userId} then cs.seller_unread else cs.buyer_unread end as unread_count, case when cs.seller_id = #{userId} then 'seller' else 'buyer' end as my_role, case when cs.seller_id = #{userId} then cs.buyer_id else cs.seller_id end as target_user_id, u.name as target_user_name, u.avatar as target_user_avatar from chatsession cs left join `user` u on u.id = case when cs.seller_id = #{userId} then cs.buyer_id else cs.seller_id end where cs.seller_id = #{userId} or cs.buyer_id = #{userId} order by cs.last_time desc, cs.id desc
select g.id as goods_id, g.seller_id, g.title as goods_title, g.cover as goods_cover, g.status as goods_status from goods g where g.id = #{goodsId} limit 1
